meta.name: dev-deep-interview
meta.description: Socratic questioning to crystallize vague requirements into a testable spec. Use when input is ambiguous, when the user asks for "deep interview", or before dev-autopilot if the brief is too broad. Pairs with @echo-analyst.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用苏格拉底式提问把模糊需求变成可测试规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常收到模糊需求，需要结构化追问来明确规格
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague requirements into testable specs with Socratic questioning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive ambiguous requirements and need structured probing to clarify specs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在收到模糊需求时，主动通过苏格拉底式提问来澄清细节，直到产出可测试的规格文档，然后存入项目文件。
howto.when: 当你的需求描述含糊不清、主动要求“深度面试”、或在使用开发辅助前需求太宽泛时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个登录页面，但先面试我。
say.note: Claude会开始逐一提问，明确范围与标准。

say.text: 我想改进网站性能，先问清楚我的需求。
say.note: Claude会评估各维度清晰度并展开追问。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude proactively uses Socratic questioning to clarify vague requirements, outputting a testable spec file before proceeding to code or plans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when input is ambiguous, user explicitly asks for "deep interview", or before dev-autopilot if the brief is too broad.

say_en.text: Help me design a login page, but interview me first.
say_en.note: Claude starts asking questions to clarify scope and criteria.

say_en.text: I want to improve site performance, ask me questions first.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates clarity dimensions and begins Socratic loop.
